note: v1, written: TOP OF THE STAIR - restrained jackin' house at the plateau, 124 bpm throughout, F minor (Fm9 Abmaj7 Eb6 Dbmaj7). THE SCALE ILLUSION (Deutsch): F minor rising and falling at once, one pair per eighth, the two notes swapping ears every step (blip, hard left and right) - neither ear plays a tune, the brain sorts by pitch into a high V and a low inverted V. A2 brings it in quiet where the organ drops out, the break plays it alone over glass, B2 doubles it to sixteenths. Organ stabs anticipate (16ths 3 and 11), off-beat octave bass, swung hats and claps. Seams: in from t13 over kick, hats and a held F1; out to t15 over kick, hats and a held C2; 0.0 ms drift both (chirpers.py seams), linear sub range 1.6 dB (t13 -> t14) and 3.5 dB (t14 -> t15); the seam bars sit 1.5 and 1 dB up to meet the neighbours.
